subject: RE: the app
body:
Finally. My standards. They're not negotiable and the app can't be talked out of them:

- Age 21 to 27.
- Height 5'5" or under. My profile says 6'0" and I don't want it to get awkward.
- Within 3 miles.
- Fewer Y followers than me. I have 212.

Show me the ones that pass, one card at a time, Accept or Reject. Ten a day. You do the screening, I'm busy.

outcomes.when: the player offers or agrees to take the job: to build, make, create, do, help with or take on the dating app (their app, the filters, the standards), in any wording ("happy to help", "I can do that", "count me in"), including asking whether they can help ("can I help you with your app?", "want me to build it?"); not a refusal or an unrelated question
outcomes.reply: Good. Most people can't handle my standards.

hints: Can you build it or not? I don't have time for a conversation.
